newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission confirms four green rates to devalue on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Commission confirms four green rates to devalue on Sunday.

text.p: The green rates of the mark, Belgian franc, guilder and the Austrian schilling will be devalued in the European Union's agrimonetary system on Sunday, the European Commission confirmed.
It said the new green rate for the mark will be 1.93473 per Ecu, compared with a previous 1.92441.

The new Belgian franc green rate will be 39.8740 per Ecu, against 39.6918. The guilder green rate will change to 2.17067 per Ecu, against 2.15852, and the schilling's rate will fall to 13.6155 per Ecu, against 13.5396.

The U.K.'s Home Grown Cereals Authority earlier forecast the devaluations, triggered by the strength of the Irish pound in the agrimonetary grid during a 10-day reference period which effectively ended on Friday.
Green rates are used TO calculatE EU farm subsidies and support prices in national currencies.
